This patch corrects CLI/MCP contract drift, issue milestone clearing, and local
release packaging. Existing clients should account for these contract changes:

- Repository metadata no longer includes `private`. No replacement visibility
  value is inferred; this read verifies identity/default branch, not publication
  visibility or authority for a later write.
- Cached source list, search, and standalone backlinks share a default page size
  of 20 and a limit range of 1–100. Use `offset` to retrieve later pages. Embedded
  source backlinks and aggregate sync status retain their complete coverage.
- Foreground collection sync with omitted bounds is a bounded preview, not a
  full backfill: default `per_page` is 100, with a 30-second operation deadline
  when the caller supplies none. Inspect `traversal_status`, `stop_reason`, and
  `continuation`; use explicit larger bounds or durable maintenance for more work.
- Omitted sync selectors use the binding's configured `issues`/`wiki` scopes.
  Explicit unavailable scopes fail before fetching; they are not silently dropped.
  Immediate daemon results report admitted collection intent, not completed work.

Explicit milestone clearing remains distinct from omission. Partial write
readback is evidence, not a success receipt: preserve the same idempotency key
for reconciliation instead of issuing a duplicate mutation.

`repo set-scopes` updates an existing exact local binding without remote sync,
identity replacement, or deletion of cached records. Capability parity does not
mean exposing every action on every surface; intentional exclusions remain.

Release builds reject dirty source trees and suppress native macOS AppleDouble
archive entries. No cache migration, daemon restart, provider setup, or automatic
local installation is performed by this release workflow. YAML tool authorization
profiles (#213) remain outside this patch.
